name: Flaky Checkout Healer
idea: Generates synthetic Thai test data and quarantines flaky checkout tests, proposing fixes with Codex.
twist: Synthetic data covers messy Thai addresses (หมู่, ซอย, ตำบล) and Buddhist-era dates, the inputs that actually break checkout.
sources: Avalon (UiPath AgentHack 2025 (global, online), Agentic Testing 1st place) — Agent that generates synthetic test data for test orchestration.
SoloPath (UiPath AgentHack 2025 (global, online), Agentic Testing 2nd place + Business Ready Agent) — Agentic testing tool that detects anomalies and eliminates flaky tests.

name: Rice Mill Maintenance Crew
idea: Five agents watch community rice-mill sensor logs, read Chinese and Thai manufacturer PDFs, and raise repair work orders.
twist: Defers non-urgent repairs during harvest peak and pre-orders parts when the mill's run hours surge.
sources: ARIA (Anthropic Built with Opus 4.7 Claude Code Hackathon 2026 (virtual), Best Use of Claude Managed Agents) — Factory maintenance system using five agents to monitor machine health and generate diagnostics and repair work orders from manufacturer PDFs.

name: Island Microgrid Agent
idea: Balances solar, battery and diesel for an island grid serving resorts and homes, scheduling loads to avoid blackouts.
twist: Adapts to monsoon cloud cover and tourist high-season loads on islands like Koh Tao, protecting clinics first.
sources: Project LUCID (SAS Hackathon 2025, Global Champion Industry Energy Track) — AI energy analytics system using IoT, forecasting, anomaly detection and digital twins to improve grid resilience and renewable usage.

name: หมู่บ้าน Solar Swap
idea: Lets households in a Thai housing estate auto-trade surplus rooftop solar with neighbours at a fair internal price.
twist: Re-prices automatically when the utility tariff (Ft) changes and pauses trades during grid outages.
sources: YellowGrid (CleanTech Hackathon 2025 (ENERGY EXPO), 1st place, Bucharest) — Energy management platform letting prosumers monitor their production and trade surplus energy based on real-time market prices.

name: EV Rider Charge Planner
idea: Books battery-swap and charging slots for electric delivery riders based on their order queue and battery level.
twist: Re-plans instantly when a swap station goes offline or rain floods a route, keeping riders earning.
sources: Energy Agent AI (Agent Development Kit Hackathon with Google Cloud 2025 (online), North America winner) — Multi-agent system that transforms energy-utility customer management using Google ADK orchestration.

name: AWD Paddy Agent
idea: Controls irrigation pumps for alternate wetting and drying rice from water-level sensors, cutting water and methane.
twist: Follows irrigation canal water-release schedules and gives Isan-dialect voice updates when it overrides the plan.
sources: Terra-Optima (FAO Reboot the Earth Hackathon 2025 (Morocco edition), 1st place, Rabat) — Agricultural platform combining AI, IoT field sensors and open data to help farmers raise yields, cut resource use and adapt to climate.

Field Advisor (FAO Reboot the Earth Hackathon 2025, 2nd place, Rome) — Voice-powered RAG assistant giving farmers localized advice on crop selection, soil management and pest control for climate-resilient decisions.

name: ASF Farm Sentinel
idea: Watches pig-farm mortality logs and nearby outbreak reports, triggering biosecurity lockdown steps when risk rises.
twist: Raises the risk level automatically when trucks from outbreak provinces are scheduled, common in Thai pig trading.
sources: AgroSentinel (4th FAO-CAAS Youth Hackathon on One Health 2025, 3rd prize (New Service Track)) — Satellite-guided early warning system combining remote sensing and AI to monitor antimicrobial resistance and zoonotic disease risk on farms.

name: Burn Scar Watch
idea: Reads mock satellite hotspot feeds, predicts smoke drift and alerts village heads before fires spread.
twist: Re-targets alerts when the wind shifts and drafts burn-ban reminders for northern provinces during the haze season.
sources: EcoGuardian.AI (AI x City Climate Action Hackathon 2025 (Global Covenant of Mayors), winner, Climate Week NYC) — Uses AI, GIS and remote sensing to detect land degradation in real time and produce risk maps and alerts for cities.
GeoSentinel AI (Vista Equity Global Hackathon, Peer Choice)

name: CBAM Evidence Agent
idea: Collects electricity bills and production logs from a Thai exporter and keeps an EU-ready emissions report current.
twist: Recalculates everything when Thailand's grid emission factor or EU rules change, listing which shipments are affected.
sources: Tese (G20 TechSprint 2024 (BIS & Banco Central do Brasil), winner, Brazil) — Builds ESG dashboards that streamline sustainability reporting for small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: Harvest Credit Line
idea: Adjusts working-capital credit limits for durian and longan buyers from mock trade data and harvest calendars.
twist: Cuts exposure automatically when farm-gate prices crash or export borders close, and explains each change in plain Thai.
sources: Kaleidofin (G20 TechSprint 2024 (BIS & Banco Central do Brasil), winner, Brazil) — Provides data-driven credit assessment tools with predictive risk models to finance businesses through innovative debt structures at lower cost.

name: เกรงใจ Collector
idea: Runs polite soft-collection on overdue SME invoices via LINE and email, offering instalments before escalating.
twist: Stays inside Thai debt-collection hours and wording rules, and softens tone when a debtor reports hardship.
sources: Claimsio (MAS Global FinTech Hackcelerator 2025, winner, Singapore FinTech Festival) — AI-native debt collection service for SMEs that replaces collection agencies with automated soft-collection workflows and factoring.

name: Panic-Sell Guard
idea: Detects panic behaviour in MariBank-style savers during market drops and sends personalised, rule-checked nudges.
twist: Adapts its nudges to each saver's goals and pauses during bank-run rumours, escalating to human advisers.
sources: Oxford Risk (MAS Global FinTech Hackcelerator 2025, winner, Singapore FinTech Festival) — Trains bank AI models on behavioural insights into investor decision-making to deliver hyper-personalised financial advice.

name: Small-Cap Rumour Desk
idea: Monitors Thai small-cap stock news and filings and updates an analyst note when a claim appears in investor chats.
twist: Checks LINE-group pump rumours against SET filings and flags likely manipulation instead of repeating hype.
sources: POLARLYST AI (SEC/TDRI/CMDF/FETCO Hackathon 'Transforming the Thai Capital Market' 2025, Thailand, 1st) — AI platform that automatically produces real-time analyst reports on small and mid-cap Thai stocks that lack analyst coverage.
TradeSageAI (Agent Development Kit Hackathon with Google Cloud 2025 (online), Honorable Mention #2) — Multi-agent financial analysis platform that evaluates trading hypotheses.

name: รถจมน้ำ Claim Agent
idea: Assesses flood-damaged cars from photos and water-line marks, pre-approving simple claims and flagging fraud.
twist: Shifts to surge mode after big floods, triaging thousands of claims and catching photos reused from earlier disasters.
sources: InsureScan (Alibaba Cloud AI Hackathon Malaysia 2025, 1st) — AI that analyses claim documents and images to detect vehicle damage and assess claim validity, speeding up insurance claims and resisting fraud.

Kava (HackMIT 2025, Cambridge MA, EigenCloud Sponsor Prize track winner) — AI tool that generates complete insurance claims in minutes from uploaded documents and damage photos, inspired by the 2025 California wildfires.

name: Phone Crack Fixer
idea: Coordinates insurer, repair shop and courier when a buyer cracks a phone bought with Shopee device protection.
twist: Re-books another repair shop automatically when parts are out of stock, keeping the buyer's promised return date.
sources: Agent Halo Agent Networks (Salesforce TDX 2025 Agentforce Hackathon, San Francisco, 1st place) — Agentforce agent network connecting insurers, repair shops and emergency responders to remove delays in the customer claims journey.
